methods.label: Adjacent angles and opposite sides
methods.explanation: Adjacent angles of a parallelogram are supplementary, so \(\angle B=180^\circ-70^\circ=110^\circ\). Opposite sides are equal, so \(CD=AB=3\).
methods.levelReason: Direct application of Grade 8 parallelogram properties with supplementary-angle arithmetic.
